claim: To raise an ineffective assistance of counsel claim on direct appeal, a defendant must make specific allegations of the conduct that constitutes deficient performance, and failure to do so renders the claim insufficiently alleged.
initial_reasoning: In State v. McCoy, 984 N.W.2d 261 (Iowa 1999), the Iowa Supreme Court held that on direct appeal a defendant must allege the specific conduct that allegedly constituted deficient performance; a failure to do so makes the ineffective‑assistance claim insufficiently alleged. The citation directly supports the claim.
